For example, a 10-week program of isolated eccentric and concentric resistance exercise reported similar increases in muscle volume between conditions (31). However, evaluation of hypertrophic changes along the length of the muscle found greater distal growth with eccentric training, whereas the growth in the midportion was greater with concentric training. Collectively, the findings indicate a benefit to combining the two types of action when the goal is maximal muscle development.
